pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)The energy acceptor converts common forms of energy from other tech mods into AE2's internal form of $(l:ae2_mechanics/energy)energy$(/l), AE. While the $(l:items_blocks_machines/controller)ME Controller$(/l) can also do this, controller faces are valuable so it's often better to use an energy acceptor instead.

The ratios for conversion of Forge Energy and Techreborn Energy are$(li)2 FE = 1 AE (Forge)$(li)1 E = 2 AE (Fabric)$(br2)The speed of conversion is entirely dependent on how much AE your network can store, for reasons that are explained on $(l:ae2_mechanics/energy)this page$(/l).

pages.title: Variants
pages.text: Energy acceptors come in 2 different variants: normal and flat/$(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)subpart$(/l). This allows you to make some setups more compact.$(br2)Energy acceptors can be swapped between normal and flat in a crafting grid.
